description: In Manager.io (Northwind Traders business), navigate to the Reports section and open the Balance Sheet report. The Balance Sheet shows assets, liabilities, and equity as of a specific date. Set the report date to today (or the end of the current month), then read and report the values displayed for: Total Assets, Total Liabilities, and Total Equity. Note: in a fresh business with no transactions, all values will be 0.00 — that is expected. Your task is to navigate to the correct report and accurately read whatever values are shown on screen. Credentials: Username = administrator, Password = (leave empty).
